---
title: "Archy 459 Lab 1: Lithic Data Cleaning"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

#load our data
lithic_data <- read_csv("lithics_raw.csv")

#clean the data
lithic_data_clean <- 
lithic_data |> #'then' cmd/ctrl +shift + m 
  mutate(length_mm = parse_number(length_mm)) |> 
  mutate(platform_mm = parse_number(platform_mm))

```
